source_row.item_data_json: {"options":{"A":"Assuming the client cannot understand anything being said to them","B":"Speaking loudly and quickly to convey information efficiently","C":"Avoiding any attempt at communication until speech therapy resolves the aphasia completely","D":"Using simple, clear language, allowing extra time for response, and incorporating gestures or visual aids as needed"}}
source_row.rationale: Effective communication strategies for a client with aphasia include using simple, clear language, allowing extra time to process and respond, and incorporating gestures or visual aids as needed, never assuming the client's comprehension is entirely absent.
